description: This file declares the StateHandler class, which manages lifecycle state transitions within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes static methods for initializing, changing, and updating states, as well as sending events and validating state transitions. The class relies on external interfaces and classes such as ILifecycleManager, ApplicationContext, and State. It also manages state transition mappings and strings for representing states.

classes.name: StateHandler
classes.description: A class providing static methods to handle state transitions, validations, and notifications within the lifecycle management framework.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the StateHandler, setting up necessary static state or configurations.

methods.name: changeState
methods.description: Attempts to change the lifecycle state based on a request and reports errors if any.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Constructs a new State object based on application context and desired lifecycle state.

methods.name: isValidTransition
methods.description: Validates whether a transition from one lifecycle state to another is permissible based on predefined transition paths.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the current application context with a new lifecycle state and reports errors if any.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Dispatches lifecycle state change events to notify other components of the transition.

methods.name: getStatePath
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence of states leading to a target lifecycle state within the given application context.
